finding: P1 - staging backend does not grant CORS to the ephemeral Vercel Preview origin
howDiscovered: Live headless-browser execution of the authenticated login flow; the app surfaced 'Cannot connect to TINA backend'.

preflightEvidence.method: OPTIONS /login with Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method headers (origins redacted)

inBrowserIsolation.conclusion: Connectivity and credentials are valid; the sole blocker to representative browser use is the missing CORS grant for the Preview origin.

rootCause: security/cors-policy.js fails closed for origins not present in the staging CORS_ORIGIN/ALLOWED_ORIGINS allowlist (correct security behavior). The allowlist includes the production origin but not the per-deployment Preview origins.
remediationOptions: Add a stable Preview alias/origin to staging ALLOWED_ORIGINS
Extend security/cors-policy.js to allowlist the project's Preview-origin pattern under a controlled credential-safe flag (separate approved task)
Validate rendered UX against a backend whose CORS allows the Preview origin
governanceNote: No runtime code modified. The fix is deployment/config or a separately-approved cors-policy change.
